capabilities.description: Runs shell commands such as builds and tests.
Only reads; never changes files. Safe for reviews and questions.
Good at reviewing changes and finding problems.
Good at planning work and breaking it into steps.
Good at writing and fixing tests.
Can search or read the web.
Handles very large inputs (big diffs, many files).
Runs on this machine; nothing leaves it.
Can open a session you talk to (interactive steps). afl adds this itself.
Can continue an earlier conversation. afl adds this itself.
Honours a step's permission mode and allowed tools. afl adds this itself.
Can be given MCP servers as extra tools. afl adds this itself.
